query: Let's build the 'Vendre une moto' funnel for logged-in B2B users — it should step through the vehicle info, keys, papers, photos and price like the public one.
Add the company registration flow: SIRET + company name on step 1, then the account step, then the nom/prénom/téléphone/département/ville coordonnées.
The invited-colleague signup needs to prefill the email from the invite link and make it read-only, then ask for a password and their coordinates.
i need the phone field on the b2b signup to only accept 10 digits and show a proper error if it's wrong
Write the Zod schema for the b2b vehicle submission — marque or modèle required but not both, at least one photo, everything else optional.
On the état dropdown, when someone picks 'En Panne' also reveal a text field asking about the nature of the breakdown.
stub out submitCompanyRegistration for now — simulate latency and log in dev, we'll wire Firebase auth + firestore later
Can you review my new steps.tsx for the invited registration? Want to make sure I'm using the controlled wrappers and useWatch correctly.
The photos step should require at least one photo before the Suivant button works.
Add a searchable département dropdown to the coordonnées step of the registration.
Add a negotiatedPriceHistory array field to the Dossier type in the Firestore schema and keep the converter in collections.ts in sync.
The région dropdown on the back-office dashboard isn't restoring the saved value after an app restart — fix the persistence.
Write Firestore security rules so a b2b user can only read dossiers belonging to their own companyId.
The chat composer's Envoyer button should be disabled while the message input is empty.
Validate the incoming request body of the sendB2cSubmission Cloud Function with a Zod schema before it sends the emails.
The sign-in card's photo background looks stretched on iPad — make it cover the screen properly.
The DossiersSection empty-state text should be centered and use the muted color token.
Set up the EAS build and submit profiles so we can ship the B2B app to TestFlight.
Generate the NORTH/SOUTH team notification email HTML for a new vehicle submission.
The DossierCard subtitle should display the cylindrée in cc next to the model name.
